## Tips & gotchas

- The H233b is considered as tough or tougher than the Dana 44. [t2183]
- [Partial] The factory H223B rear axle is considered tough and strong enough to handle a locker without immediate failure. [t1477]
- Front lockers may put more stress on the front end due to CV joints and locking hubs. [t1477]
